newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico port shipped 234.9 mln bbls of hydrocarbons.
newsitem.headline: Mexico port shipped 234.9 mln bbls of hydrocarbons.

text.p: Mexico's second largest crude oil port, Pajaritos in Veracruz state, shipped a total 234.89 million barrels of hydrocarbons in 1996, state-owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said in a statement on Wednesday.
Crude export volume at Pajaritos for the year totalled 147.98 million barrels, and 459,540 barrels were shipped domestically, Pemex said.
The port averages 300,000 barrels of crude per day according to the company's latest public figures.

Of last year's cargo, 65 percent corresponded to domestic and foreign crude shipping, 23 percent to petroleum by-products, six percent to refrigerated gases, four percent to petrochemicals and the remaining two percent to imports, Pemex said. It gave no comparative figures for 1995.
